name: hasFPowerSeriesWithinOnBall_iff_exists_hasFPowerSeriesOnBall
statement: E → F} {p : FormalMultilinearSeries 𝕜 E F} {s : Set E} {x : E} {r : ℝ≥0∞} : HasFPowerSeriesWithinOnBall f p s x r ↔ ∃ g, EqOn f g (insert x s ∩ eball x r) ∧ HasFPowerSeriesOnBall g p x r

name: AnalyticWithinAt.exists_mem_nhdsWithin_analyticOn
statement: E → F} {s : Set E} {x : E} (h : AnalyticWithinAt 𝕜 f s x) : ∃ u ∈ 𝓝[insert x s] x, AnalyticOn 𝕜 f u
